paper.title: Dex-X: Learning Visual-Tactile Dexterous Manipulation From Human Videos with Simulated Interaction
paper.tldr: Dex-X reconstructs human demonstrations in simulation, learns a tactile-aware expert, and distills it into a point-cloud and fingertip-force policy. Evaluation covers six simulated task categories and four real tasks on a Sharpa Wave hand, including 28/30 cube picks and 16/30 squeegee trials without real-world fine-tuning.

paper.evaluation: Simulation and real robot
paper.notes_zh: 部署仍依赖重定向运动参考；触觉表示为每指尖的标量力幅值。

source.title: BORA: Bridging Offline Reinforcement Learning and Online Residual Adaptation for Real-World Dexterous VLA Models

evidence.paraphrase: 第III-A与III-C节共享VLM表示训练动作条件critic，在线冻结VLA并以离线/在线混合经验更新残差actor。

paper.title: BORA: Bridging Offline Reinforcement Learning and Online Residual Adaptation for Real-World Dexterous VLA Models
paper.tldr: BORA couples an action-conditioned VLA critic with human corrections and online residual adaptation while freezing the base policy. Across six real-robot tasks on two hand platforms, 20 online trajectories per task raise standard-object success from 60.8% to 82.5%; the assisted twisting actor does not observe contact forces.

paper.evaluation: Real robot; simulation-trained local twisting assistance
paper.notes_zh: 成功率增益同时包含新增在线数据与残差更新的影响，不能归因于残差算法单一因素；不添加Tactile feedback。

paper.title: Deformable In-Hand Slip-Aware Tactile Sensor with Integrated Velocity Sensing, Force/Torque and Pressure Map Estimation
paper.tldr: A deformable tactile module combines optical sliding-velocity measurements with magnetic force/torque and pressure-map estimation. Bench characterization and 100 closed-loop sliding trials on a custom parallel gripper demonstrate its relevance to in-hand manipulation; transparent surfaces and strong curvature limit tracking.
paper.tldr_zh: 柔性接触垫集成光学滑移速度测量与磁式力/力矩、压力图估计。在台架及定制平行夹爪的100次闭环滑动试验中验证手内操作用途；透明表面与较大曲率会限制跟踪。

paper.notes_zh: 无多指灵巧手验证；闭环控制器沿用先前工作并重新调参，本文创新集中在传感器。

runtime_tactile.paraphrase: 第IV-D节闭环滑动控制实际使用一个已安装传感器的读数：滑动阶段用速度反馈，粘滞阶段用力反馈。

paper.title: DexHoldem: An Agentic Robotics Benchmark for Dexterous Manipulation in Texas Hold'em
paper.tldr: DexHoldem benchmarks real ShadowHand card and chip manipulation using 1,470 teleoperated demonstrations and 14 primitives. paper.title: SoTa: Soft Tactile Skins for Dexterous Manipulation
paper.tldr: SoTa gives human and robot hands matching 202-taxel capacitive skins and a shared tactile encoder. Three real-robot tasks test touch and co-training; the full method raises mean success across eight conditions from 22.8% to 45.9%.

paper.title: PointWAM: 3D World Action Modeling for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
paper.tldr: PointWAM jointly forecasts scene and hand trajectories in 3D, then retargets hand forecasts to robot commands. Human-video pretraining precedes robot-demonstration fine-tuning. paper.title: GOTT: Object-centric Dexterous Manipulation with a Reusable Cross-Embodiment Primitive
paper.tldr: GOTT separates reaching, contact acquisition, and object-motion tracking. A shared reinforcement-learning primitive uses local hand–object geometry and proprioceptive history across hand designs. paper.title: DexAgent: An Agentic Human2Sim2Robot Framework for Dexterous Manipulation with Self-Evolving Tool Library
paper.tldr: DexAgent converts a human video into robot training data through object-aware reconstruction, verified trajectory generation, and simulation augmentation. Evaluation separates human-data reconstruction and simulated trajectory checks from bimanual Sharpa replay and learned-policy tests on eleven real tasks.

paper.tldr: TacOT matches human and robot demonstrations using action–tactile temporal alignment and optimal transport while training a multimodal flow policy. paper.title: AgenticTactileVLA: Contact-Guided Execution-Time Supervision for Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation without VLA Retraining
paper.tldr: An execution supervisor checks and corrects finger closure around a fixed VLA, retaining accepted grasps or returning control for retries. paper.title: PatternDex: Learning Interaction Patterns to Guide Reinforcement Learning of Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation of Articulated Objects
paper.tldr: PatternDex learns interaction tokens from human object–wrist motion and decodes robot-specific wrist and contact guidance for reinforcement learning. paper.title: Now You Feel It, Now You See Me: Digital-Twin-based Teleoperation Interface for Dexterous Manipulation
paper.tldr: A digital-twin AR interface supports bare-hand teleoperation of two dexterous hands by displaying fingertip forces and revealing occluded grasp regions. sensing: Tactile measurements visualized to the operator
paper.evaluation: Real-robot teleoperation user study
paper.notes_zh: 触觉显示进入人类操作者反馈回路，未声称有自主触觉策略；未添加Tactile feedback标签。未报告下游策略学习收益。

paper.title: VICON: Visual-Inertial-Contact based Hand-Object Tracking for Manipulation Datasets
paper.tldr: VICON combines RGB-D, glove inertial tracking and measured human contact to refine hand–object trajectories under occlusion. Evaluation uses human manipulation recordings, including 40 motion-capture sessions over five rigid objects; robot policy learning remains future work.
paper.tldr_zh: 融合 RGB-D、惯性手套和人类接触测量，以因子图修正遮挡下的手物轨迹。在五种刚性物体的 40 段动捕序列上评测追踪；机器人策略学习仍属后续工作。
paper.evaluation: Human manipulation recordings; 40 motion-capture sessions within 71 recorded sessions; no robot policy evaluation
paper.notes_zh: FSR接触测量来自人类采集手套，未评测机器人策略；官方仓库目前只有说明，完整数据仍待发布。

source.title: FlashDexRetarget: Accelerating Dexterous Manipulation Data Generation through Multi-Motion Retargeting

review.reason_zh: 主要贡献是面向多指机器人手的人类动作重定向与数据生成，方法和仿真评测明确。真实验证为轨迹回放，未证明特权状态策略可在实机闭环部署。

paper.title: FlashDexRetarget: Accelerating Dexterous Manipulation Data Generation through Multi-Motion Retargeting
paper.tldr: A shared off-policy tracking policy retargets many human hand–object demonstrations using geometric interaction rewards and separate hand-wise actor–critics. Tests cover 50 motions on two simulated hands, scaling to 1,000 references and physical trajectory replay; deployment still depends on privileged simulation states.
paper.tldr_zh: 共享离策略跟踪策略结合几何交互奖励和左右手独立 actor–critic，批量重定向人类示教。评测涵盖两种仿真手、50 段动作、千段扩展及实机轨迹回放，未实现实机观测闭环策略。
sensing: Privileged simulated robot and object states
paper.evaluation: Isaac Sim benchmark and scaling study; physical XHand trajectory replay
paper.notes_zh: 真实硬件只回放仿真产生的轨迹；策略依赖特权仿真状态，不能据此声称已实现实机观测闭环迁移。

paper.title: Mask2Real-WM: Controllable Dexterous World Models via Segmentation Masks as a Sim-to-Real Bridge
paper.tldr: Mask2Real-WM separates action-conditioned mask dynamics from RGB rendering, using simulation to broaden motion coverage and 2.5 hours of real demonstrations for adaptation. On an ORCA-hand setup, blind video ratings and prediction metrics assess command following; downstream control success is not evaluated.
paper.tldr_zh: 将动作条件掩码动力学与 RGB 渲染分开，用仿真扩展动作覆盖，再以 2.5 小时真实示教适配。在 ORCA 手平台数据上盲评视频动作响应及预测质量，尚未评估下游控制成功率。
paper.evaluation: Simulation and real robot datasets; generated-video controllability and perceptual metrics
paper.notes_zh: 评测的是动作条件视频生成与感知质量，尚未报告利用该世界模型的规划或闭环策略成功率。

source.title: DEXTERA: From a Single Image to Deployable Dexterous Manipulation via Real-to-Sim-to-Real

paper.title: DEXTERA: From a Single Image to Deployable Dexterous Manipulation via Real-to-Sim-to-Real
paper.tldr: DEXTERA combines single-image asset reconstruction with additional metric calibration, task primitives and synthesized demonstrations for dexterous policy learning. paper.tldr_zh: 由单图生成资产，结合额外度量标定、任务原语和合成示教训练灵巧策略。在两套实机的 13 个任务—平台组合上分别验证轨迹回放与闭环策略，并比较仿真和真实数据混合训练。
paper.evaluation: Scene reconstruction, physical trajectory replay, and separate simulation/real closed-loop policy evaluations

paper.title: DITTO-X: Forward and Reverse Teleoperation for Dexterous Manipulation and Human Intervention

paper.title: EgoSteer: An Open-Source Full-Stack System Towards Steerable Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Videos

paper.title: ReDex: Repairing Sim-to-Real Dexterous Policies by Finger-Level Compliant Interaction
